Package hadur2.core.port

Class GatedProfileStore

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.port.GatedProfileStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
ProfileStore
public final class GatedProfileStore extends Object implements ProfileStore
A ProfileStore with a gate on writes and deletes (A4): a write or delete the gate refuses never reaches the store, and is counted. Reads are never gated. The conductor's Archive asks mayWrite(java.lang.String) before it lets a shelf save, so a gated save is never attempted; a delete a library makes on its own, such as an eviction, is refused quietly and counted (SHELF-1, SHELF-3, and from A5 SHELF-2).

    • lastModified

      public long lastModified(String name)
      Description copied from interface: ProfileStore
      MEM-13: when name was last written, as a number that only grows with later writes; 0 when unknown. The library forgets the least recently written profiles first, and a profile's file is written only when its opponent is fought, so this orders opponents by when they were last met without reading a single profile.
      Specified by:
      lastModified in interface ProfileStore
